dialogue.chat: A chat works. It's the one chore you can do sitting down.
dialogue.chat/1: A chat's the one chore you can do lying down. So — go on, %1$s.
dialogue.chat/2: Sure, talk. It pairs nicely with sitting, which I was already committed to.
dialogue.conversations: Talking? Fine. Sit down first, %1$s — standing conversations always run long.
dialogue.conversations/1: Sure, let's talk. Pull up something to lean on first. No sense standing through it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations/2: Talk away. I was going to do nothing anyway — might as well do it with company.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Been good. Slept in, skipped a chore, the world kept turning. Suspicious how well that works.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Good. Did the bare minimum and the sky didn't fall. Vindicating, honestly.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Comfortable. That's my version of thriving. Warm patch, full belly, no one needing me.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Rough, honestly. Even my naps have been tired lately, %1$s. That's how I know.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: Off, lately. Even resting's been hard work, which is the worst news a man like me can get, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You asked already. I haven't moved, and neither has the answer. Restful, isn't it?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice now? That's more effort than I've spent all morning. Still fine. Still sitting.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Found the sunny patch by the well and stayed in it. The day arranged itself around me.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Claimed the sunny spot by the well early and defended it all day. A triumph, in its way.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: Someone expected things of me before noon. The day never recovered.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Somebody wanted something before I'd finished waking up. Ruined the whole schedule of nothing I'd planned.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: I like the parts between the parts. The leaning, the waiting. Done right, that's most of the job.
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: I like the pauses. The lean, the stretch, the long look at the horizon. That's the good part, and I'm expert at it.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: The work's fine. It's the doing of it. Every chore would improve with a hammock nearby.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: The work's fine in theory. It's the lifting and the doing. Everything's better within reach of a chair.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s? Good sunny spots, gentle hills, a well close enough that fetching water's almost restful. Ideal, really.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: I've napped in every corner of %2$s, %1$s. That's how you truly know a place — where the best shade falls.
dialogue.conversations.people.first: Good folk. They do the bustling so I don't have to. Lovely arrangement. I supervise from the fence.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: Nice neighbors. Half of them think I'm asleep and say the interesting things nearby. Best gossip in the village, and I never move.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Anything I don't have to chase, catch, or cook. A pie someone else made, ideally, brought to where I'm sitting.
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Bread within arm's reach. The whole trick to eating well is not having to get up for it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: My whole life, %1$s? That's a lot of sitting to tell. Luckily I was sitting for most of it. Get comfortable.
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: A long, comfortable sit of a life, %1$s. Not much walking in it. Settle in, I'll get to the good parts eventually.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A porch facing the sunset, so the day ends where I'm already sitting. Perfect dream. No walking in it at all.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: A porch, a sunset, and nothing on the far side of the fence asking for me. That's the whole dream. Perfect as is.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That I'll doze through the one day that actually mattered. I don't sleep as easy as folks think.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Sleeping through the one day that counted. People think I rest easy. I don't, quite, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: You're the one visit I don't need a nap to recover from, %1$s. From me, that's poetry.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: You're the one visit worth sitting up for. Don't let it swell your head — I still won't be standing.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: That question needs sitting up straight for, and I barely know you. Come back — I'll save you a spot on the fence.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: That's a sit-up-straight kind of question, and I've only just met you. Come back — the fence has room.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: Some things I only say lying in the grass with someone I trust. We're not that far along. Yet.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: Those I save for lying in the grass with someone I trust. We'll get there. No rush. Never a rush, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: News takes effort to happen, and nobody's bothered. My kind of week.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Nothing. News is effort, and nobody could be bothered. Suits me down to the ground.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy? You're the one thing worth getting up for, %1$s — and I still usually don't have to. That's the dream.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: With you, doing nothing finally feels like doing everything. Best deal I ever lazed into. Yes.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage: %2$s and %3$s got hitched. Nice do, apparently. I heard it from the fence without getting up. Efficient.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage/1: Word is %2$s married %3$s. Good for them. Weddings are a lot of standing, so I'm glad it wasn't mine.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce: %2$s and %3$s called it quits. Shame. Splitting up sounds like even more work than staying together, if you ask me.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce/1: %2$s and %3$s aren't a pair anymore. I won't take sides — takes too much energy to hold an opinion that firm.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: %2$s passed, %1$s. ...Sorry. Even I sat up straight for that one. Rest easy, wherever the easy chairs are.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/1: We lost %2$s. Quiet loss. I've been sitting with it most of the afternoon, which is about all I can do.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: %2$s had a baby. New little one in the village. All that crying — glad the napping's their job now, not mine.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/1: There's a new baby over at %2$s's place. Sweet little thing. Sleeps all day, which is frankly the dream, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival: %2$s moved in. New neighbor. I'll get around to waving eventually — no rush, they only just got here.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival/1: Somebody new turned up — %2$s. Seems fine. I'll form a full opinion after a nap or two, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure: %2$s packed up and left the village. All that hauling and loading. Just thinking about it makes me want to lie down.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure/: %2$s moved away for good. Bit of a shame. That was a good fence to lean on near their place, too.
